解答 令 $y_1=x，y_2=x^x，y_3=x^{x^x}$，则 $y'=y_1'+y_2'+y_3'$，$\ln y_2=x\cdot\ln x$，则 $\frac{y_2'}{y_2}=\ln x+1，y_2'=x^x(1+\ln x)$，同理，

$$\ln\ln y_3=x\cdot\ln x+\ln\ln x，\text{对 }x\text{ 求导可得 }\frac{1}{\ln y_3}\cdot\frac{y_3'}{y_3}=\ln x+1+\frac{1}{x\ln x}，$$

$$y_3'=x^{x^x}\cdot x^x\ln x\cdot\left(\ln x+1+\frac{1}{x\ln x}\right)$$

$$=x^{x^x}\cdot\left[x^x\ln x\cdot(\ln x+1)+x^{x-1}\right]$$

则有 $y'=1+x^x(1+\ln x)+x^{x^x}\cdot\left[x^x\ln x\cdot(\ln x+1)+x^{x-1}\right]$

$$\ln\ln y_3=x\cdot\ln x+\ln\ln x，\text{对 }x\text{ 求导可得 }\frac{1}{\ln y_3}\cdot\frac{y_3'}{y_3}=\ln x+1+\frac{1}{x\ln x}，$$

$$y_3'=x^{x^x}\cdot x^x\ln x\cdot\left(\ln x+1+\frac{1}{x\ln x}\right)$$

$$=x^{x^x}\cdot\left[x^x\ln x\cdot(\ln x+1)+x^{x-1}\right]$$

则有 $y'=1+x^x(1+\ln x)+x^{x^x}\cdot\left[x^x\ln x\cdot(\ln x+1)+x^{x-1}\right]$
